items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Bonnie Bigard and Albert Nicholas worked with King Oliver. At the plantation.

ctx.x: I was going to say, do you remember where he worked or what he did when he played? Or did you ever hear him on the job anyplace? No. He never, no.

He never took me out to a nightlife. The only place he took me to one time is because I, Bonnie Bigard and Albert Nicholas worked with King Oliver. At the plantation. And he took me to the plantation so I could hear them. And I mean, I wasn't there an hour, I don't believe, because he said, my eyes were big as soft as looking around. I had never seen the cabaret before.
So your grandmother wouldn't have approved at all. Oh my goodness, no.
